description:
Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, merchant, creature, event and combat background skins, with previews in the Other Compendium.

[h2]1.0.38[/h2]
The compendium's switch entry ("Other Compendium") is back on the stable build: the Vakuu art patch now skips itself when its target method is missing instead of rolling back the whole ancient module. Card art held by other players is no longer invalidated when a run ends; a third-party pack that throws inside the card pipeline is contained instead of blanking portraits; a load-order risk notice warns about same-name files and duplicate mod assemblies. Carried from 1.0.37: material packs with a .cardartpack.json are isolated from the game PCK, Ancient plates and frames resolve per install, and Hibiki Amane, NonoFoolSkin and Hina are supported.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch skins in character select and compendiums, or adjust appearance during a run.
[*]Organize your choices with priorities, presets, skin combinations and bundles.
[*]Browse the curated Workshop catalog and subscribe or unsubscribe in-game.
[*]Customizable themes and 15 interface languages.
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
Offline compatibility checks passed for stable v0.111.1 and beta v0.113.1. Special-code skins may still need individual adaptation.
Skins are subscribed separately. Skin Changer adjusts its load order and prompts for a restart when needed.

[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Skins with special code, gameplay changes or custom managers may need compatibility work.
[*]Newly subscribed skins may need a restart; check their Workshop labels.
[/list]

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
https://github.com/WhiteCatKing/STS2-SkinChanger-dev

[h2]Version[/h2]
1.0.38

[h2]Submissions[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292752301/]Submit a mod on Steam[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/WhiteCatKing/STS2-SkinChanger-dev/blob/main/STS2-SkinChanger_%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E4%BB%B6/docs/publish-github-skin-mod.md]GitHub mod submission guide[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292746467/]Submit a theme preset[/url]
[/list]

This mod was developed with substantial assistance from GPT and DeepSeek. More feature requests and suggestions are welcome!
changeNote:
1.0.38 / 2026-11-22
正式版（v0.111.1）图鉴右上角的「切换」入口不再消失：瓦库彩蛋补丁在目标方法不存在的版本上改为整类跳过，不再连带让 ancient 模块的 15 个补丁整体回滚。
Fixed the missing compendium switch entry on the stable build: the Vakuu art patch is skipped as a whole when its target is absent, so the ancient module no longer rolls back.
对局结束清理时不再让别人手里的卡图失效；卡牌管线里第三方包抛的异常被单独拦下，不再让牌面空白；新增加载顺序风险提示（皮肤包与游戏本体同名文件、两个 Mod 程序集同名等会提前告知）。
Card art held by other players is no longer invalidated by run cleanup; exceptions thrown by third-party packs inside the card pipeline are contained instead of blanking portraits; a new load-order risk notice warns about same-name files and duplicate mod assemblies.

1.0.37.3 / 2026-11-21
卡图：带 .cardartpack.json 的素材包（如愚者卡面美化 v5.01）现在也会隔离原始 PCK，选「游戏默认」不会再显示它们的图；皮肤包里和游戏本体同名的共享图集文件不再写进全局；原版缺图的卡会回退到同卡的 Beta 图，不再整张被换掉；先古卡的说明底图与边框按实际游戏包找位置，半透明的 NOPE 占位不再出现。
新增 Mod 兼容：响木天音的选角按钮不再显示成贞德头像；NonoFoolSkin（愚者动画皮肤）出现在愚者下拉框并带选人界面预览；选中空崎日奈时只拦它改卡牌原版图路径的那一个补丁，头像、语音、卡框配色照常保留。
其他：正式版商人房间路径按实际场景查找，不再写死测试版拆分出来的场景；卡牌图鉴左下角的「皮肤优先级 / 有皮肤卡牌」挪到搜索框上方，不再被返回箭头挡住；独立召唤 Mod 接管骨手时不再误报「应用角色外观失败」。
Card art: material packs that ship a .cardartpack.json (e.g. Fool Card Beauty v5.01) are now isolated from the game PCK, so choosing "Game default" no longer shows their art; files inside a skin pack that share an atlas name with the game are no longer written globally; a card whose vanilla art is missing falls back to the beta art of the same card; Ancient card plates and frames are resolved from the actual pack, so the translucent NOPE placeholder is gone.
New mod compatibility: Hibiki Amane select button no longer shows Joan portrait; NonoFoolSkin appears in the Fool list with a character-select preview; with Hina selected only its card-art path patch is blocked, portraits, voice and card frame colours stay.
Other: merchant room paths on the stable version are resolved from the actual pack; the card compendium priority/preset controls moved above the search box; the false "failed to apply appearance" prompt no longer appears when a summon mod owns Osty.
